body.name: Selected certified one-shot procedure
body.construction: First compare \(M_n\) with \(n\). If \(M_n\ge n\), do not form \(\pi_i(G)\), \(Q_G\), \(w_i(z;G)\), or \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}\); assign \(Z=\mathbf 1_n\), report \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{cert}}=n^{-1}\sum_{i\in V_n}y_i(\mathbf 1_n)\), and set \(\overline U(G)=1\). If \(M_n<n\), form the seed objects and \(U(G,k_n)\); use \(Z^{\mathrm{seed}}\), report \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{cert}}=\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}\), and set \(\overline U(G)=U(G,k_n)\) when \(U(G,k_n)\le1\), while returning the same all-treated fallback and \(\overline U(G)=1\) when \(U(G,k_n)>1\).
